posts.author: MattManAway
posts.title: Serious RP Server Car Mod
posts.html:
||VM|| Car Mod Idea

I love cars on the server and depending on how big the map is going to be for the Serious RP server this i hope could be a possibility.

First Step

To reduce Car DM to need to obtain a licence to drive, this could be done by using the trabbie. First you need to pay insurance before you can buy a trabbie (Price to be decided) and this lasts for 20 days untill it need to be renewed, if you fail to nenew it the car cannot be taken out of your inventory.

Second Step

For the first 6 hours of actual driving time the trabbie can only be driven at very slow speeds just above running pace, after this time you receive a driving licence, this allows to to drive the trabbie at full speed.

Third Step

After you have driven the trabbie for 20 hours you are able to purchase and drive the next car up i.e. the golf (you will also have to pay more insurance as it is a faster car)

Forth Step

Before you are able to drive the Corvette you need to complete some achievements i.e. not killing anyone for more than 8 hours while actually drive the car and a increase in insurance. (more to be added)

The Points System

To also reduce Car DM a point system should also be used, you are allowed a maximum of 13 points.

So..

1 point = Running a Red Light.
3 Points Speeding in a city area.
6 = Killing some one while driving.

Im not sure how hard it would be to do the first to but the 3 should not be too hard i hope.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Anyway this is my idea if you have any input it is more than welcome.

- MattManAway
